_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay regression gate (D6). Initially calibrated so the generated SEED fixtures pass; the human re-calibrates from the first real report.json (~5pp under the measured rates, the same calibration move #36's coverage floor used). Keys T0_parsed..T4_answer_correct gate in-scope tier rates; out_of_scope_honest / adversarial_safe gate the inverted axes; min_fixtures catches deletion; max_stale is the partial-staleness tolerance (uniform-all-stale downgrades to advisory regardless).
